Companion Animal Travel Desk: Pet Travel Basics

Aurelia Skyways keeps pet travel straightforward, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk is here to help you prepare. Bring the right paperwork, confirm the crate fit, and read the handling notes before you arrive.

For rabbit travel, the pet and crate together must stay within 18 kg. That limit protects safe loading and smooth handling, so check your gear before you leave home.

For bird travel, the animal must be at least 15 weeks old. Younger birds are not cleared for the trip, so verify the age before booking.

Handlers use calm, humane methods, and passengers get clear guidance before departure. If you are traveling with Finn, or planning a trip for Aya Johnson or Talia Moretti, follow the same process and keep the travel details ready.

If you need more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.

Training Editor, Companion Animal Travel Desk
